reason: Reproduced on Linux x86_64 using installed uv 0.12.13 and CPython 3.12.3, with isolated temporary caches and dependency-free local PEP 517 backends. Started `uv build --wheel --python /usr/bin/python3 <project>`, waited for backend readiness, killed only uv with SIGKILL, then ran plain `uv cache clean`. Cleanup succeeded and removed the surviving backend’s environment; its subsequent write failed with ENOENT and its delayed import failed with ModuleNotFoundError. Separately, `UV_CONCURRENT_BUILDS=2 uv pip install --python <venv>/bin/python <slow-project> <failing-project>` reproduced both failures after a sibling build error, without signals or cache cleanup. As a comparison, `uv cache prune` on 0.12.13 retained the environment and both probes succeeded. The reported macOS/uv 0.12.23 combination and newer PR prune revision were not executed. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with commands, fixtures, observations, inspected test coverage, and validation limits; retained reproduction artifacts alongside it. No checkout files or GitHub state were changed.
